execution_policy.branch_layout: The working directory is an offline export of the pull request's repository. Local branch `main` is the merge-base and local branch `review-head`, which is checked out, is the head under review; the change under review is the committed range `main...review-head`. There is no remote, no network, and nothing outside this attempt's directories is available.
execution_policy.allowance: Reading the clone is always permitted. Commands may be run only as the target's allowance below states, offline, with a five-minute limit per command; scratch files go under the work directory; nothing may be added to or changed in the clone, whose tree identity is checked before and after the review.
